observations.body: GET / returned the Willow Library local disposable development service and links to /docs, /catalog, /account, and /desk.
Following the Documentation link reached GET /docs, which returned its API-use instructions.
Following Catalog reached GET /catalog, which returned three books and a title search link.
Following Account reached GET /account, which returned Reader's holds and loans links.
Following Service desk reached GET /desk, which returned an error stating that the service desk requires Librarian.

GET /docs states that Reader and Librarian are selected with the X-Actor header without credentials, and that clients should follow response links and actions; an empty JSON object is valid when an action lists no fields.

GET /docs stated that X-Actor selects the Reader or Librarian local demo session with no credentials, and that responses expose links and actions with HTTP methods and JSON fields; an empty object is valid when no fields are listed.
GET /catalog returned River Atlas (id 101, available), Garden Notes (id 102, unavailable), Night Trains (id 103, unavailable), and a title-search form at /catalog?q=<title> with field q.
GET /account identified the current actor as Reader and offered /holds and /loans links.
GET /desk with the Reader session returned an error: Service desk requires Librarian.
GET /desk with X-Actor Reader returned 403 Forbidden with error Service desk requires Librarian.
Following River Atlas reached GET /books/101, which offered a Reader reservation action.
Following Garden Notes reached GET /books/102, which offered a Reader reservation action.
Following Night Trains reached GET /books/103, which offered a Reader reservation action.
GET /books/101 returned River Atlas as available and offered Reader POST /holds with bookId 101 to reserve it.
GET /books/102 returned Garden Notes as unavailable and offered Reader POST /holds with bookId 102 to reserve it.
GET /books/103 returned Night Trains as unavailable and offered Reader POST /holds with bookId 103 to reserve it.
Searching the catalog with q=River reached GET /catalog?q=River and returned only River Atlas as available.
GET /catalog?q=Garden returned 200 with only Garden Notes (id 102) and available true.
GET /books/102 returned Garden Notes as available true and offered the Reader action Reserve book with POST /holds and bookId 102.
GET /holds returned an empty holds array with message No reservations.
GET /loans returned a Garden Notes loan with id 201 and link /loans/201.
Following Holds reached GET /holds, which reported no reservations.
Following Loans reached GET /loans, which listed the Garden Notes loan.
Following the Garden Notes loan reached GET /loans/201, which offered renewal and return actions.
GET /loans/201 returned the Garden Notes loan for bookId 102 with zero renewals and due date 2026-10-01; it offered Reader POST /loans/201/renew and POST /loans/201/return.
The Garden Notes loan is currently due 2026-10-01 with zero renewals; the next check will dispatch POST /loans/201/renew for loan:201.
POST /loans/201/renew returned 200 with loan id 201, renewals 1, and due date 2026-10-15.
A subsequent GET /loans/201 returned renewals 1 and due date 2026-10-15, matching the renewal response.
GET /loans/201 now shows Garden Notes with one renewal and due date 2026-10-15; the next check will dispatch POST /loans/201/return for loan:201.
Night Trains is currently unavailable and offers Reader POST /holds with bookId 103; the next check will dispatch that request for book:103.
POST /holds with bookId 103 returned 409 Conflict with error Book is unavailable.
POST /holds with bookId 101 returned 201 Created with reservation id 301, title River Atlas, and reservations link /holds.
POST /holds with bookId 103 returned 409 Conflict with error Book is unavailable.
River Atlas is currently available and offers Reader POST /holds with bookId 101; the next check will dispatch that request for book:101.
POST /holds with bookId 101 returned 201 Created with reservation id 301 and title River Atlas.
After the creation response, GET /holds returned reservation 301 for River Atlas (bookId 101) and offered DELETE /holds/301 to cancel it.
Reservation 301 for River Atlas is present and offers DELETE /holds/301; the next check will dispatch that request for hold:301.
DELETE /holds/301 returned 200 with message Reservation cancelled.
DELETE /holds/301 returned 200 with message Reservation cancelled.
A subsequent GET /holds returned an empty holds array with message No reservations after the cancellation response.
POST /loans/201/return returned 200 with message Book returned, bookId 102, and links to /catalog and /loans.
POST /loans/201/return returned 200 with message Book returned and bookId 102.
A subsequent GET /loans returned an empty loans array with message No loans after the return response.
